title: Quick PIN
body: On a trusted device, open the app with a 6-digit PIN. Exports and security changes still ask for your password or passkey.
useHere: Use the PIN on this device
removed: PIN removed. Every trusted device is forgotten.
saved: PIN saved. This device can now be opened with the PIN.
confirmNew: Type it once more to confirm
mismatch: The PINs did not match. Start again.
rules: Avoid runs or repeats such as 123456 or 111111.
lockHelp: After this much idle time the app asks for the PIN again.
noDevices: None yet. Create the PIN on the device you want to use.
welcome: Welcome back, {name}. Enter your PIN to open.
wrong: Wrong PIN. {left} tries left before the password is needed.
usePassword: Sign in with password or passkey
pin_locked: Too many wrong PINs. Sign in with your password, then create the PIN again.
pin_device_unknown: This device is no longer trusted. Sign in with your password.
rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a moment.

pin.tooSimple: That PIN is too easy to guess. Avoid runs or repeated digits.
